style.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshot and info screens, deep slate-blue aged wood #3C4654 with burlap linen for appetite hero scenes, soft light linen #F4F0E8 for table scenes
style.iconSystem: consistent solid hexagonal and circular badges plus thin-line icons, single accent color #E86A1E or #5E9C46
style.lightingSystem: warm directional soft key from the front-left with soft contact shadows on dark scene shots; bright even high-key flat lighting on white info screens; no harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh farm-to-table fruit ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white background #FFFFFF, deep slate-blue aged wood #3C4654, orchard green #5E9C46, charcoal text #2D2D2D and one vivid orange accent #E86A1E; warm directional soft key light with soft contact shadows on dark scenes and bright even high-key on white info screens; modern geometric sans-serif headlines in charcoal or white only; consistent solid hexagonal and circular info badges with thin-line icons; crisp appetizing fruit photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale; every frame composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and consistent fruit scale across the set; halved fruit always shows pit centered
style.surfaceSystem: aged slate-blue wood boards, coarse burlap linen, matte white ceramic plate and matte light board #EFE9E1
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines in charcoal #2D2D2D on light screens and #FFFFFF on dark or orange screens, labels 10-14pt
